obfuscation_indicators: adequate to cover probable incurred losses
risk_summary: The excerpt is highly quantitative and reports growth in assets, loans, deposits, earnings, and regulatory capital, supporting a generally stable-to-positive tone. Credit-risk disclosure acknowledges subjective allowance estimates, economic uncertainty, acquired-loan accounting, and changing collateral and nonperforming-loan conditions. Repeated cross-references and dense accounting language reduce accessibility but do not appear overtly evasive.
